en.headline: Housing Bureau says 93.2 per cent of Wang Fuk Court owners signed sale agreements before deadline
en.dek: A total of 1,850 owners across the eight blocks completed the Agreement for Sale and Purchase after the October 15 deadline, with remaining cases to be handled individually.
body: The Housing Bureau said on Friday that 93.2 per cent of owners at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po had signed the Agreement for Sale and Purchase before the deadline expired on Thursday.
A total of 1,850 owners from Blocks A to H completed the agreements, covering the eight residential blocks of the estate that was affected by a major fire last year.

The bureau said some owners were unable to sign in time because of special circumstances, including probate, bankruptcy, title disputes, cases involving mentally incapacitated persons, or owners currently outside Hong Kong.

Officials noted that similar issues arise in private-market transactions and said the government may consider case-by-case arrangements while balancing empathy, reason and law, with priority given to empathy. The bureau added that it would continue the assignment procedures at full speed to complete the transfer of titles.

zh.headline: 房屋局指王福苑九成三業主在截止前簽署買賣合約
zh.dek: 八座樓宇共有1,850名業主完成買賣合約，佔總數的百分之九十三點二，餘下個案將個別處理。
body: 房屋局周五表示，大埔王福苑業主簽署買賣合約的截止日期已於星期四屆滿，百分之九十三點二業主已完成簽署。
八座樓宇（A至H座）共有1,850名業主已簽署買賣合約，占整個屋苑單位總數的百分之九十三點二。
房屋局指，部分業主因特殊情況未能及時簽署，包括需較長時間處理業權問題（如遗囑認證、破產、業權糾紛）、涉及精神上無行為能力人士，或業主目前人在境外等。
發言人指，類似情況在私人市場交易中亦會發生，政府可按情況個別考慮適當安排，平衡同理、法及情，以同理優先。房屋局表示會繼續全力跟進轉讓程序，完成業權轉移。
